decisions.reason: Although bread is central to the bakery, this older loaf was not seen on later website observations and could have been replaced by other staple breads in a medium-sized range.
The guided historic mill tour matches the heritage concept, but it is more operationally demanding and its absence from later website observations makes withdrawal relatively likely.
The sweet pastry fits the core confectionery offer, yet as a fairly standard extension not seen later online it is easy to discontinue in favor of stronger sellers.
Crusty farmhouse bread is very close to everyday bakery demand and uses existing craft capabilities, so it is likely to remain in the assortment.
The poppy seed Christmas stollen is a flagship seasonal product with a gold-award signal, which strongly supports keeping it on the market.
The premium Christmas stollen is also award-backed and well suited to festive and gift purchases, so it is likely to stay unless the seasonal range is simplified.
